messages.subject: Issue with Boxplot - annotate
parts:
I am learning R and am trying to replicate the boxplot shown in "Figure 5.4" in the book. I have tried both checking and unchecking the "Annotate" checkbox. But in both cases I only get the same black/white boxplot without any annotations.

I have the latest version of R and Rattle on windows 7.
The steps I took are:
1. started R
2. library(rattle)
3. rattle()
4. loaded weather dataset
5. selected distributions in the Explore tab
6. selected boxplot option for Humidity3pm 
7. checked the Annotate check box.
8. Execute...

I have attached the resulting boxplot.





Am I missing something?

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Issue with Boxplot - annotate
parts:
Annotate is not fully implemented on the new graphics. To replicate the figures in the book, please unselected Advanced Graphics under Settings.

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
